entries.en: Added `rate_limits` field to statusline scripts for displaying Claude.ai rate limit usage (5-hour and 7-day windows with `used_percentage` and `resets_at`)
entries.zh: 在状态行脚本中添加了`rate_limits`字段，用于显示 Claude.ai 速率限制使用情况（带有`used_percentage`和`resets_at`的 5 小时和 7 天窗口）

entries.en: Added `source: 'settings'` plugin marketplace source — declare plugin entries inline in settings.json
entries.zh: 添加了 `source: 'settings'` 插件市场源 — 在 settings.json 中内嵌声明插件条目

entries.en: Added CLI tool usage detection to plugin tips, in addition to file pattern matching
entries.zh: 除了文件模式匹配之外，还为插件提示添加了 CLI 工具使用情况检测

entries.en: Added `effort` frontmatter support for skills and slash commands to override the model effort level when invoked
entries.zh: 添加了对技能和斜杠命令的“努力”frontmatter 支持，以在调用时覆盖模型努力水平

entries.en: Added `--channels` (research preview) — allow MCP servers to push messages into your session
entries.zh: 添加了`--channels`（研究预览）——允许 MCP 服务器将消息推送到您的会话中

entries.en: Improved responsiveness of `@` file autocomplete in large git repositories
entries.zh: 改进大型 git 仓库中 `@` 文件自动补全的响应速度

entries.en: Improved `/effort` to show what auto currently resolves to, matching the status bar indicator
entries.zh: 改进 `/effort`：显示 auto 当前实际解析为哪个级别，与状态栏指示一致

entries.en: Improved `/permissions` — Tab and arrow keys now switch tabs from within a list
entries.zh: 改进 `/permissions`：在列表内按 Tab 和方向键即可切换标签页

entries.en: Improved background tasks panel — left arrow now closes from the list view
entries.zh: 改进后台任务面板：在列表视图中按左方向键即可关闭

entries.en: Simplified plugin install tips to use a single `/plugin install` command instead of a two-step flow
entries.zh: 插件安装提示简化为一条 `/plugin install` 命令，不再是两步流程

entries.en: Reduced memory usage on startup in large repositories (~80 MB saved on 250k-file repos)
entries.zh: 大型代码仓库的启动内存占用降低（25 万文件的仓库节省约 80 MB）

entries.en: Fixed `--resume` dropping parallel tool results — sessions with parallel tool calls now restore all tool_use/tool_result pairs instead of showing `[Tool result missing]` placeholders
entries.zh: 修复了`--resume`删除并行工具结果的问题 - 具有并行工具调用的会话现在恢复所有 tool_use/tool_result 对，而不是显示“[工具结果丢失]”占位符

entries.en: Fixed voice mode WebSocket failures caused by Cloudflare bot detection on non-browser TLS fingerprints
entries.zh: 修复非浏览器 TLS 指纹被 Cloudflare 机器人检测拦截，导致语音模式 WebSocket 失败的问题

entries.en: Fixed 400 errors when using fine-grained tool streaming through API proxies, Bedrock, or Vertex
entries.zh: 修复了通过 API 代理、Bedrock 或 Vertex 使用细粒度工具流时的 400 个错误

entries.en: Fixed `/remote-control` appearing for gateway and third-party provider deployments where it cannot function
entries.zh: 修复了网关和第三方提供商部署中出现的`/remote-control`无法运行的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/sandbox` tab switching not responding to Tab or arrow keys
entries.zh: 修复了`/sandbox`选项卡切换不响应 Tab 或箭头键的问题

entries.en: Fixed managed settings (`enabledPlugins`, `permissions.defaultMode`, policy-set env vars) not being applied at startup when `remote-settings.json` was cached from a prior session
entries.zh: 修复了当从先前会话缓存`remote-settings.json`时，启动时未应用托管设置（`enabledPlugins`、`permissions.defaultMode`、策略集环境变量）
